mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AccountTrade ( account_trade_day, account_trade_money, account_source, account_trade_type, bank_account_num ) VALUES ( #{accountDay}, #{accountMoney}, #{source}, #{accountType}, #{bankAccountNum} )

INSERT INTO CardTrade ( card_trade_day, card_trade_money, card_store_name, business_num, industry, card_trade_type, category_id, card_num ) VALUES ( #{cardDay}, #{cardMoney}, #{cardStoreName}, #{businessNum}, #{industry}, #{cardType}, #{categoryId}, #{cardNum} )
mapper.select: SELECT ct.card_trade_day, ct.card_store_name, ct.card_trade_money, ct.business_num, cg.category_name, mc.card_name FROM CardTrade ct JOIN MyCard mc ON ct.card_num = mc.card_num LEFT JOIN Category cg ON ct.category_id = cg.category_id WHERE mc.member_id = #{memberId} AND ct.card_trade_type = 'expense' ORDER BY ct.card_trade_day DESC

SELECT at.account_trade_day, at.account_trade_money, at.account_source, mb.bank_account_name, mb.bank_name FROM AccountTrade at JOIN MyBank mb ON at.bank_account_num = mb.bank_account_num WHERE at.account_trade_id = #{accountTradeId}

SELECT mc.card_name, mc.card_type, mc.card_num, ct.card_trade_day, NULL AS cancel_day, ct.card_trade_money, ct.card_store_name, cg.category_name, ct.business_num FROM CardTrade ct JOIN MyCard mc ON ct.card_num = mc.card_num LEFT JOIN Category cg ON ct.category_id = cg.category_id WHERE ct.card_trade_id = #{cardTradeId}
